diff_bytes.description: Bytes of each side of a diff.

svg_id_bytes.description: Bytes of an `id` in an SVG drawing.

views.title: Her views

cable_grants.title: Operations with Cables in one job
cable_grants.description: Operations one job grants Cable actions in.

message_bytes.title: Longest message
message_bytes.description: Bytes of one job's message; Universal Exports refuses a person's longer message.

context_bytes.title: Standing context and recap
context_bytes.description: Bytes of a job's standing context and recap together; a recap stays under half.

event_bytes.title: Longest reported event
event_bytes.description: Bytes of one reported event's text; longer text is cut.

change_bytes.title: File content in one commit
change_bytes.description: Bytes of file content in one commit.

shared_bases.title: Shared change bases
shared_bases.description: Shared-change bases one event carries, and Universal Exports keeps for one conversation until their calls arrive.

personal_walk.title: Files looked at per turn
personal_walk.description: Files of her personal folder looked at to name what a turn changed.

page_file_bytes.title: Largest file read for a page
page_file_bytes.description: Bytes of one file the Station reads to publish a page.

page_files.title: Files read for a page
page_files.description: Files the Station reads to publish one page.

page_bytes.title: All the files read for a page
page_bytes.description: Bytes over all the files of one page the Station reads.

image_bytes.title: Largest image in a message
image_bytes.description: Bytes of one image a message carries.

limits.title: Messages
limits.description: What passes between Universal Exports and a Station for her.

idle.title: Close an idle harness after
idle.description: Seconds a harness waits for the next message, or writes nothing while answering, before it is closed; `"none"` keeps it.

live.title: Harnesses on one Station
live.description: Harnesses a Station runs or starts at once; past it a message is refused and another Station is asked.

token_margin.title: Restart before a token expires
token_margin.description: Seconds before its tool token expires that a running harness is restarted with the job's; a job with another token restarts it whatever is left.

job_wait.title: Job poll held open
job_wait.description: Seconds Universal Exports holds a job poll open.

job_bytes.title: Largest job
job_bytes.description: Bytes of one job as Universal Exports sends it.

call_margin.title: Extra time for a request
call_margin.description: Seconds a request to Universal Exports may take past what it waits for.

job_retry.title: Retry a failed job poll after
job_retry.description: Seconds before a failed job poll is tried again, and the least between polls when Universal Exports answers early.

report_queue.title: Reports waiting to be sent
report_queue.description: Ordinary reports (her text, her tool calls) waiting to be sent; past it the newest are dropped.

report_attempts.title: Tries to send a report
report_attempts.description: Times a report is sent before it counts as lost.

report_retry.title: Retry a report after
report_retry.description: Seconds between tries of a report that did not reach Universal Exports.

known.title: Conversations remembered for a resume
known.description: Conversations whose provider Session the desk remembers for a resume.

close_wait.title: Wait for a closing harness
close_wait.description: Seconds a message waits for the conversation's closing harness.

limit_fallback.title: Out for this long at a limit with no reset time
limit_fallback.description: Seconds a route or account stays out when a harness reports a limit with no reset time.

remove_retry.title: Retry removing a directory for
remove_retry.description: Seconds removing a closed harness's directory is tried again.

unlocked_stale.title: Sweep abandoned directories after
unlocked_stale.description: Seconds before a directory of working directories left without its lock, or a lock without its directory, is swept.

clone_timeout.title: Longest clone
clone_timeout.description: Seconds a clone of one of her repositories may take.

clone_bytes.title: Largest clone
clone_bytes.description: Bytes a clone of one of her repositories may hold on disk, then it is given up and removed.

save_bytes.title: Largest save of her work
save_bytes.description: Bytes one save of her work in her personal folder may commit; past it nothing is saved and she is told.

held_cables.title: Cables held per conversation
held_cables.description: Cables one conversation holds for the person's confirmation; past it a send is refused, and nothing the person has not seen to is dropped to make room.

held_cable_ttl.title: A held Cable waits
held_cable_ttl.description: Seconds a Cable held for the person's confirmation waits before it is dropped.

page_upload_timeout.title: Longest page file upload
page_upload_timeout.description: Seconds sending one file of a page to Universal Exports may take.

desk.title: Her desk on each Station
desk.description: How each Station runs her harnesses.

conversations_per_person.title: Conversations per person
conversations_per_person.description: Conversations kept for one person; the oldest goes first.

conversation_age.title: Keep an untouched conversation for
conversation_age.description: Seconds a conversation is kept untouched.

conversation_bytes.title: Entries kept per conversation, in size
conversation_bytes.description: Bytes of entries kept per conversation; the oldest go first.

person_bytes.title: Entries kept per person, in size
person_bytes.description: Bytes of entries kept per person; a person's views go first.

live_per_person.title: Live conversations per person
live_per_person.description: One person's conversations with a harness running or an answer pending; the least recently used idle harness is closed to make room.

tool_calls_per_minute.title: Tool calls a minute
tool_calls_per_minute.description: Tool calls one conversation makes in a minute.

token_ttl.title: A tool token lasts
token_ttl.description: Seconds a tool token given to a harness is accepted; past it, while that harness's answer runs and its Station was heard from within `answer_deadline`, until the person stops it.

token_reuse_margin.title: Keep a token if it still has
token_reuse_margin.description: Seconds a token must still have to be given to the next message; kept above `[assistant.desk] token_margin`.

answer_timeout.title: A Station takes up a message within
answer_timeout.description: Seconds a Station has to take up a message before another is asked.

answer_deadline.title: Give up on a silent answer after
answer_deadline.description: Seconds an accepted message may go without word from its Station before it is given up.

proposal_ttl.title: A proposal waits
proposal_ttl.description: Seconds a proposal waits for the person's confirmation.

proposals.title: Proposals waiting per conversation
proposals.description: Proposals waiting for the person in one conversation.

message_bytes.title: Longest message a person writes
message_bytes.description: Bytes of one message the person writes.

memory_context_bytes.title: Memory summaries in her context
memory_context_bytes.description: Bytes of her memory's summaries in a new harness's context; the job's context bound applies as well, and she can search for what does not fit.

change_message_chars.title: Longest shared change message
change_message_chars.description: Characters of the one-line message of a shared change she proposes.

recap_bytes.title: Longest recap
recap_bytes.description: Bytes of the recap a conversation's new harness starts with.

ready_entries.title: Entries sent when a conversation opens
ready_entries.description: Entries the app is sent when it opens a conversation.

ready_bytes.title: Size of the entries sent then
ready_bytes.description: Bytes of entries the app is sent when it opens a conversation.

socket_message_bytes.title: Longest message on the app's socket
socket_message_bytes.description: Bytes of one message on the app's socket.

hello_timeout.title: The app's socket says hello within
hello_timeout.description: Seconds the app's socket has to say hello.

max_wait.title: Longest job poll
max_wait.description: Seconds a Station's job poll may be held open, also while `assistant = false`.

sweep_every.title: Look for jobs nobody took every
sweep_every.description: Seconds between an open conversation's looks for jobs no Station took up.

shared_base_wait.title: A shared change waits for its base
shared_base_wait.description: Seconds a shared change waits for its Station's report of what it was made from.

event_buffer.title: Events queued for open sockets
event_buffer.description: Events queued for one conversation's open sockets; a socket that falls further behind is closed.

route_bytes.title: Largest route answer to her tools
route_bytes.description: Bytes of an AI6 route's answer to one of her tools.

result_chars.title: Longest tool answer she is given
result_chars.description: Characters of one tool's answer she is given; longer is cut.

author_chars.title: Longest name and email on her commits
author_chars.description: Characters of a person's name and email on her commits.

audit_target_bytes.title: Longest audit record target
audit_target_bytes.description: Bytes of an audit record's target.

proposal_reads.title: Reads a proposal lists
proposal_reads.description: Read tool calls of one turn a proposal lists as what she had read.

log_age.title: Keep her conversation log for
log_age.description: Seconds an entry of her conversation log is kept; `none` keeps every entry.

log_bytes.title: Her conversation log, in size
log_bytes.description: Bytes of her conversation log kept, every conversation's together; the oldest entries go first, and `none` keeps every entry.

log_prune_every.title: Trim her conversation log every
log_prune_every.description: Seconds between two passes that drop what her conversation log keeps no longer.

log_flush_timeout.title: Wait for her conversation log at a stop for
log_flush_timeout.description: Seconds a stopping gateway waits for her conversation log to keep what is still queued; `none` waits for all of it.

source_comments.title: Comments read of a tracker item
source_comments.description: Comments of a tracker item `source_item` reads, the latest.

source_wait.title: Wait for a live tracker read
source_wait.description: Seconds a live tracker read waits for the Headquarters Station to answer.

source_reads.title: Live tracker reads waiting
source_reads.description: Live tracker reads waiting for the Headquarters Station at once.

source_answer_bytes.title: Longest live tracker read answer
source_answer_bytes.description: Bytes of the Headquarters Station's answer to one live tracker read.

gateway.title: Her conversations
gateway.description: How Universal Exports keeps her conversations.

max_file_bytes.title: Largest file of a page
max_file_bytes.description: Bytes of one file of a page.

max_person_bytes.title: All of one person's pages
max_person_bytes.description: Bytes of all one person's pages.

max_total_bytes.title: All pages on this gateway
max_total_bytes.description: Bytes of all pages on one gateway.

inline_bytes.title: Largest inline page
inline_bytes.description: Bytes of an inline page's content.

feed_reads_per_minute.title: Feed reads a minute, per link
feed_reads_per_minute.description: Feed reads one link makes in a minute.

staged_uploads.title: Uploads held from Stations
staged_uploads.description: Pages Universal Exports keeps staged from Stations at once.

default_ttl.title: Keep a page for
default_ttl.description: Seconds a page lives unless remembered.

open_ttl.title: A view of a page lasts
open_ttl.description: Seconds a frame's view token, which the page's files and feeds are named under, is valid. A reload names a new one.

handoff_ttl.title: A hand-off to a browser lasts
handoff_ttl.description: Seconds a hand-off, the single-use token an app's request gives a browser that holds no page cookie, may wait to be used. A restart ends one not yet used.

handoffs.title: Unused hand-offs per person
handoffs.description: Hand-offs one person holds unused at once; past it, their oldest ends.

upload_wait.title: Wait for a Station's files
upload_wait.description: Seconds a publish waits for the Station's files.

stage_ttl.title: Keep an unclaimed upload for
stage_ttl.description: Seconds a staged upload no call claims is kept.

sweep_every.title: Sweep expired pages every
sweep_every.description: Seconds between sweeps of expired pages, links and staged uploads.

network.title: What a page may reach
network.description: What a page may reach from the browser.

feeds.title: Dashboards read live feeds
feeds.description: Whether dashboards may read live feeds.

frame.title: Show the classification bar
frame.description: Whether a page's frame shows the classification bar. The page stays in the gateway's frame either way, which names the view token of its files and feeds.

sharing.title: People may share pages
sharing.description: Whether a person may share a page.

max_shares.title: Subjects a page is shared with
max_shares.description: Subjects one page is shared with.

public.title: People may make public links
public.description: Whether a person may give a page a public link, which opens it for anyone holding the link, with no sign-in and no feeds. Off, every public link stops answering.

pages.title: Her pages
pages.description: The pages she publishes and how they are served.

sections.title: Work and shared work
sections.description: Where she keeps each person's work, and what teams share with her.

sections.title: What she can reach
sections.description: What her scripts may run and which hosts she may reach.

max_operation_depth.title: Deepest Operation tree
max_operation_depth.description: How many levels the tree of Operations may have, a root being the first. A missing parent or a cycle is refused whatever this says.

max_compartment_rules.title: Largest compartment
max_compartment_rules.description: How many read-in and cover pairs one compartment may have.

classifications.title: Classifications, lowest first
classifications.description: A Report carries one of these or none, which is the lowest; reading it needs a clearance at or above it.

handlings.title: Handling marks, narrowest first
handlings.description: How far a Report may go.

priorities.title: Priorities, most urgent first
priorities.description: A Report's proposed or assessed urgency; one without comes last.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: `[roster.reports]`: the lists Reports are marked and prioritised from.

x-enum-labels.mission.status: See status: IDs, states, roles, times; no text

actions.title: What it grants
actions.description: What it grants on what it covers.

x-enum-labels.00: 00: acts unattended where the Operation allows

min_clearance.title: Clearance floor
min_clearance.description: The clearance a Session needs for the compartment to apply to it.

max_fanout.title: Recipients of one Cable
max_fanout.description: The most recipients one Cable to the compartment may reach.

rate.title: Cables a second
rate.description: Cables a second to the compartment, from everyone, across Stations.

burst.title: Burst of Cables
burst.description: Cables to the compartment in a burst.

sender_rate.title: Cables a second, per sender
sender_rate.description: Cables a second from one sender; `none` keeps no per-sender count.

sender_burst.title: Burst per sender
sender_burst.description: Cables from one sender in a burst; applies with `sender_rate`.

max_product_bytes.title: Size of a product text
max_product_bytes.description: Bytes of one text an Agent reads from a product; the rest is cut with a marker.

key.title: Codeword
key.description: What this compartment is known by, such as KESTREL. It cannot be changed later.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The Agent who sits here, by codename; leave it empty to name a role.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role an Agent must hold to sit here; leave it empty to name an Agent.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: How much this seat's vote counts.

veto.title: Veto
veto.description: Whether this seat sending the work back ends the round as a redo, whatever the others say.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: Who reviews: Agents or roles, each with a weight and an optional veto.

pass_at.title: Share that must pass
pass_at.description: The share of the weight, above 0 and at most 1, that must vote to pass. Abstentions are left out of the share. Leave it at 1 for all of it.

distinct_models.title: Different models
distinct_models.description: How many different models must be behind the votes, none of them the author's.

rounds.title: Rounds to agree
rounds.description: How many rounds the panel has to agree before `on_no_agreement`.

redo_limit.title: Times sent back
redo_limit.description: How many times the author is sent back before a person decides.

on_no_agreement.title: When the panel does not agree
on_no_agreement.description: What happens when the panel does not agree, or the budget runs out.

max_turns.title: Turns one review may spend
max_turns.description: Reviewer turns one review may spend. Leave it empty for no limit of its own.

max_tokens.title: Tokens one review may spend
max_tokens.description: Tokens one review may spend. Leave it empty for no limit of its own.

reviewer_timeout_secs.title: A reviewer answers within
reviewer_timeout_secs.description: How long one reviewer has to answer before it counts as absent; 0 is no limit.

key.title: Policy name
key.description: What Operations, roles and briefs choose this policy by. It cannot be changed later.
